claims: The required Terraform test fails: alerts/rules/peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 asserts that peg_slack_title contains $alert.Annotations.summary and $alert.Annotations.resolved_summary, but the new title template has neither, so the `Test Peg rule definitions` step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:874-879) fails on every PR run

New regression: a breach entered from Error loses its start, so the later clear has no duration or measured cause (peg-alert-events.ts:109-110 and :320-321). Error → Alerting is now filed as `error-recovered-alerting` and nothing opens the alert cycle, so the later Alerting → Normal shows up unpaired for any Normal → Error → Alerting → Normal sequence
The canonical runbook docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 is out of date: it still says Slack titles are "the severity icon plus that summary"

The canonical runbook docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:132-133 is out of date: it still says history "reads only fired and resolved transitions", but root AGENTS.md requires canonical docs to stay current

A rule that recovers from Error into Pending keeps a "Monitoring failed" entry with no recovery (peg-alert-events.ts:105-115, route.ts:51-54): only previous=Error&current=Normal is queried, so Error → Pending and any path through Pending never closes the Error cycle

Alerting → Error → Normal leaves the breach looking active (peg-alert-events.ts:344-352, 356): the recovery closes only the Error cycle, and the earlier raised entry stays open and keeps its "Urgent alert active" dot

The route's failure tests would pass even if validation were broken (route.test.ts:819, 832, 846): .mockResolvedValue(json(...)) hands the same Response object to all three concurrent fetches, so the second body read fails and becomes a 502 whether or not the malformed-frame, size or truncation checks work

Rules without a source get misleading failure text (peg-alert-events.ts:230-242): seven Peg rules have source = "" and pegAlertSourceName("") returns "Price source", so the failure reads "Grafana could not evaluate the Price source Peg rule"

The Slack-template lint test can't fail (scripts/alerts/alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1215-1220): if the resource marker is renamed, indexOf returns -1, the slice becomes an empty string, and both "must not contain" checks pass
In scripts/alerts/alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1258-1268, the link checks search the whole file instead of the Slack message resource

One test assertion checks nothing (recent-alerts.test.tsx:193): not.toContain("sell price is below peg") can never fail because no explanation contains that text (peg-alert-explanation.ts:247), so the test misses the case where both texts render

judge_reasoning.3830366247: Review #4 says a rule that recovers from Error into Pending is never captured, because only previous=Error&current=Normal is queried.
judge_reasoning.3830366547: Review #5 says Alerting → Error → Normal closes only the Error cycle and leaves the earlier raised entry looking active.
judge_reasoning.3830366556: Review #4 says an Error → Pending path never closes the Error cycle, leaving a stuck 'Monitoring failed' row.
judge_reasoning.3830371307: Review #8 says the lint slice does not validate marker indexes (indexOf -1 gives wrong text) and the link checks search the whole file.
judge_reasoning.3830371315: Review #6 says mockResolvedValue shares one Response across the concurrent fetches, so the second body read fails with a 502.
judge_reasoning.3830371325: The defect text is truncated, but it concerns error-recovered-alerting handling near line 352. Review #2 flags that error-recovered-alerting does not open the alert cycle, which leaves later clears unpaired.
judge_reasoning.3830371329: Review #9 says the not.toContain('sell price is below peg') assertion can never fail because no production string produces that text.
judge_reasoning.3830416461: Review #7 says source-less rules get pegAlertSourceName('') = 'Price source', which produces misleading failure text.

1.why: peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 does still require $alert.Annotations.summary and resolved_summary in peg_slack_title, which the new template drops. This is the known stale Terraform title assertion.

2.why: transitionKind (peg-alert-events.ts:108-110) now files Error→Alerting as error-recovered-alerting, and cycleKey (:320-321) puts it in the error cycle, so no alert cycle opens. The later Alerting→Normal clear finds nothing open, lands in unpairedCleared, and is shown without a duration. Before this change Error→Alerting counted as raised.

3.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 does still say titles are the icon plus the summary. This is the known item about keeping the runbook aligned with the new title.

4.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:132-133 still says the backend "reads only fired and resolved transitions". route.ts now also queries current=Error and previous=Error, and those Error transitions show up in history.

5.why: errorStateHistoryUrl in route.ts only adds current=Error and previous=Error&current=Normal, so recoveries into Pending are never fetched. This matches the known Pending recovery items (peg-alert-events.ts:114/116).

6.why: At :344-352 an Error→Normal recovery closes only the error key, so the open alert raise is left for :356 to emit. This matches the known 'Error recovery leaves breach active' (:352).

7.why: At route.test.ts:819/832/846, mockResolvedValue reuses one Response across the three remaining concurrent fetches. This is the known route.test.ts:819 item.

8.why: At :230-242 the evaluation-failure lead uses pegAlertSourceName(labels.source). This is the known ':230 Label source-less evaluation failures by rule'.

9.why: At lint test :1215-1220, if the title marker is missing, indexOf returns -1, slice(-1, n) is empty, and both negative checks pass. This matches the known alert-rules-lint.test.mjs functional-correctness item.

10.why: The link includes() checks at :1260-1268 do run on the whole templates string, but the claim names no concrete way this would hide a broken template, and the negative title checks already use the title slice.

11.why: recent-alerts.test.tsx:193 checks for a phrase that no explanation text contains (grep found no 'below peg' in peg-alert-explanation.ts). This is the known recent-alerts.test.tsx:193 item.
